authoring.author: claude-sonnet-5.5 (wallen faces lane) pass 1; claude-opus-5.5 (historic canal-house library lane) pass 2 with the historic schema
authoring.note: Oudezijds Achterburgwal 41-57 (odd, canal side), 8 pands, 9 fronts (53 and 55 share one pand). Pass 2 re-read the strip with a pixel-row ruler (staging/w zoom crops: z1-z6 gables/cornices, g1-g3 ground floors) and the Rijksmonumentenregister texts: eaves are measured on the strip (continuity.measuredEaves) because 3DBAG reads the gabled roofs behind the cornices of 45 and 49 as 1.6-1.8 m low eaves, and 57's gable foot 1.9 m low; ground storeys are separate openings (pier arcades, timber puien, door + roller shutters), not one shop glass; gables carry wing pieces, ears, cartouches and finials; 43 has a mansard with a pedimented dormer; cornices are cream over dark or red window frames.
